summary: A bridge upgrade skipped initializeV3, leaving totalOperatorWeight at zero, so minimumVoteWeight() returned 0 and a withdrawal with an empty operator signer set cleared the threshold. Whitehat; funds returned. Distinct from the March 2022 Ronin validator key-compromise.
attack_trace: Upgrade runs initializeV4 but not initializeV3, leaving totalOperatorWeight = 0
minimumVoteWeight() computed from zero total weight returns 0
Submit withdrawal with an empty signer set; the zero threshold is met and funds are released
root_cause: Deployment defect: the upgrade's initializeV3 (which sets totalOperatorWeight) was never called, collapsing the withdrawal vote-weight threshold to zero. No signatures are forged.
